note: Served when nothing else matches — most often a speech begun before anybody has ticked a memory. Short on purpose: with nothing to work from, the honest draft is a short one, and a fixture that invented three paragraphs here would be teaching the studio a bad habit.

response.openingLine: Thank you all for coming today.
body: I want to say a few things about her, and then sit down.
She was ours, and we were lucky, and this room is full because of it.
